description: This file defines the 'Slice' model class for representing data visualizations or reports in the Superset project, including methods for URL generation, data serialization, and event handling.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: Represents a data visualization or report (slice) in Superset, with properties and methods for URL generation, data serialization, and event handling.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: String representation of the Slice object.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current Slice instance.

methods.name: datasource_link
methods.description: Returns a Markup link to the datasource.

methods.name: datasource_url
methods.description: Returns the URL to explore the datasource.

methods.name: datasource_name_text
methods.description: Returns the textual name of the datasource, including schema if available.

methods.name: datasource_edit_url
methods.description: Returns the URL to edit the datasource.

methods.name: viz
methods.description: Returns the visualization object based on params and viz_type.

methods.name: description_markeddown
methods.description: Returns the description rendered as Markdown.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of data used to render the slice in templates.

methods.name: digest
methods.description: Returns a digest string for the chart, used for cache busting.

methods.name: thumbnail_url
methods.description: Returns the URL for the chart's thumbnail image.

methods.name: json_data
methods.description: Returns the JSON string of the slice's data.

methods.name: form_data
methods.description: Returns the form data dictionary for the slice, including parameters and cache timeout.

methods.name: get_query_context
methods.description: Creates and returns a query context object based on stored query_context JSON.

methods.name: get_explore_url
methods.description: Generates the URL to explore the slice with optional overrides.

methods.name: build_explore_url
methods.description: Static method to build an explore URL with given slice ID and overrides.

methods.name: slice_url
methods.description: Returns the URL to access the slice.

methods.name: explore_json_url
methods.description: Returns the URL to access the slice's JSON data.

methods.name: edit_url
methods.description: Returns the URL to edit the slice.

methods.name: chart
methods.description: Returns the slice's name or '<empty>' if not set.

methods.name: slice_link
methods.description: Returns a Markup link to the slice.

methods.name: icons
methods.description: Returns HTML icons related to the datasource.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL to explore the slice.

methods.name: get_query_context_factory
methods.description: Returns the query context factory, creating it if necessary.
